findings.text: With optional control-plane mediation disabled, capability queries report absence, storage lookup reports absence with a no-op release, shim lookup does nothing, validation and range inquiry and locked attribute mutation report unsupported, and the errno-propagation query reports affirmative.
Both inspected headers are single-inclusion guarded so repeated inclusion yields one effective definition set.

Variable offset and variable size ceilings each equal two raised to twenty ninth power, temporary string workspace spans three hundred twenty units, and decoded instruction text workspace spans thirty two units.

A full register occupies eight bytes with half width four, stack advances in four byte steps across one hundred twenty eight positions, call nesting allows sixteen frames, the main routine marker is negative one, dynamic pointer storage spans two registers, outgoing stack argument capacity equals the shortfall of register arguments, and identifier remapping capacity scales with registers plus stack words plus stack arguments times frames.

Arithmetic sanitization distinguishes source handling, destination handling, negated values, non-pointer treatment and immediate treatment in separate low bits, with a combined mask joining source and destination handling.

Register knowledge combines a kind tag with a signed link adjustment and a kind-selected payload, alongside tristate offset knowledge and two circular intervals for full and narrowed widths, plus linkage and ancestry and inner-map identity markers and a precision flag, with member order significant for equality.

Kind-selected payload can convey packet range, caller versus callee frame discrimination, owned map association, type system handle plus identifier, memory extent, dynamic pointer kind plus leading-slot marker, iterator handle plus identifier plus packed liveness plus nesting depth, interrupt helper class, raw word pair, or destination subprogram number.

Per-word stack cells pair a spilled register image with per-byte role tags distinguishing untouched, spilled, miscellaneous, constant zero, dynamic pointer, iterator, interrupt flag and poisoned uses. Activation records hold a register file, call site, frame depth, diagnostic identity, subprogram index, timer reentry count, callback return bounds, callback context markers, a stack-argument loading guard, simulated iteration depth and path instruction total, plus a stack array whose byte size stays a multiple of register width and an outgoing argument count with array.

Exploration state holds a frame vector with parent linkage and acquired references, a branch remainder with current position and frame cursor, counters for references and ordinary and preemption-disabled holdings plus active interrupt and lock identities with source pointer and read-copy-update depth, speculation and sleepability markers, a covered instruction interval, an equality cache link, and a jump log with length plus search and unroll depths.

Jump history packs instruction position in twenty bits, frame in four, slot in six, predecessor position in twenty, special access flags in four and linked precision registers in a wide word, while access flags distinguish stack access, destination being stack derived, source being stack derived and stack argument access.

Cached exploration nodes pair a full snapshot with list linkage and miss, hit and free-list bookkeeping. Loop inlining caches initialization and eligibility plus chosen callback identity. Map handle state pairs ownership with poison and unprivileged markers. Return bounds pair signed extrema with a width selector.
Iterator liveness distinguishes invalid for secondary slots, active during traversal and drained after exhaustion, with drained treated as terminal in the observed model.

Path exploration uses a remainder where zero means fully discharged, one means a single live path and two marks a fork whose fallthrough continues while a sibling waits for later visit, with discharge propagating toward exit and positive remainders on revisit hinting loops subject to layered equivalence checks and a global complexity ceiling.
Signed and unsigned extrema for full and narrowed widths derive from stored circular intervals, and range setters rebuild those intervals from supplied minima and maxima.

Spilled register recovery succeeds only when the slot lies inside the allocated window and the stored slot role belongs to an allowed mask, while stack argument recovery additionally requires an initialized kind and otherwise reports absence.

Slot presence sets use a two-word vector with empty and full sentinels, tests for emptiness and equality, bitwise combination and complement, single position membership, and bounded interval union that ignores positions beyond capacity.

Traversal helpers visit every live frame, then architectural registers, then qualifying spilled slots and outgoing stack arguments, invoking caller logic at each stop while threading current frame and stack context and filtering spills by role mask.

Nested holdings are recorded through counters for ordinary and preemption-disabled and read-copy-update scopes plus active interrupt and lock identities with a source object pointer, with reference entries distinguishing plain pointer use from interrupt and several lock flavors and validating release against the recorded source.

Stale or unsafe uses are contained by poison markers for slots and map handles, an unprivileged taint on map handles, a precision gate that discounts scalar bounds when unset, speculative execution marking, and hit, miss and free-list accounting for cached states.
Linked scalars share an identity with a constant displacement whose width class is recorded in high bits, and call arguments are designated by a mask over the first five argument registers.
Iterator type names share a common prefix that spells the three letters b p f, then underscore, then the four letters i t e r, then underscore.
Referenced symbol is owned by another dossier and is relied on here only by identity.
